Perchy answers budgie sounds only: a quick call back for a contact call, and a soft warble when your bird warbles (it sometimes just listens, as a flockmate would). Voices, whistles, hisses, knocks and clicks are ignored, and so is a call made while someone is talking.

Your phrases

Pet budgies pick up words their people say a lot and slip them into their warble. Type a phrase you often say, tap Record, say it, and tap again to stop. Perchy says it slowly in a low, buzzy budgie voice made from your bird's own warble, the way talking budgies do. It slips your phrases into its warble now and then, sometimes says one when it is in a chatty mood, and in full screen the speech-bubble button at the top says one with a single tap.

    How Perchy behaves

    So far

    Set the phone or tablet at perch height near the cage, plugged in, and keep this page open. Start at a low volume and watch how your bird takes it. Everything runs on this device and nothing is recorded or uploaded.

    Every sound is a real budgie: your own bird, from your videos, and wild budgies cut from recordings shared on xeno-canto.org under each recordist's Creative Commons license: Marc Anderson (XC134241, XC172266, XC335524, XC593111, XC594060, XC594061, XC594062, XC597623, XC609245).
